text:
emma_csm: FYI GreenLeaf opened an escalation — invoice total > dashboard by ~$512 after a mid-month plan change. They pasted the invoice vs dashboard screenshots and they're pretty upset.

oliver_support: Can you drop the numbers here? what lines differ?

emma_csm: Invoice shows Pro plan charge for the whole month + token line: 1,234,567 tokens. Dashboard shows Starter until 02/15 then Pro; dashboard token sum is ~617,283. So invoice tokens ~double. customer says they didn’t hit usage that high.

matt_billing: Hmm — is this a proration bug or double counting? Did they have multiple subs/aliases?

emma_csm: Only one active org. Billing portal shows single subscription id.

oliver_support: I'll start with a quick audit query to look for duplicate ingestion events around the cutoff.

oliver_support: Running quick repro SQL:
```sql
SELECT request_id, count(*) as hits, min(received_at) as first_seen
FROM token_events
WHERE org_id = 'org_greenleaf' AND received_at >= '2026-02-14'::timestamptz - INTERVAL '2 days'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY hits DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

oliver_support: I see ~18 request_ids with count=2 and several with count=3. Many have same request_id but different streaming chunks.

alisa_eng: That points at idempotency not being applied across stream chunks. We recently changed the streaming proxy to emit chunked frames without carrying the idempotency header through the reconnect flow.

kevin_prod: Deployment logs show a partial rollout on 2026-02-14 23:40 UTC for streaming-proxy v1.7.3. The rollback flag didn't flip because the healthcheck was green.

alisa_eng: Repro steps I used: start a streaming completion, interrupt network, let client reconnect -> server accepted new stream with same request_id but counted tokens again. Patch idea: carry Idempotency-Key across reconnects and dedupe at token ingestion joiner.

oliver_support: For immediate reconciliation — I can compute the deduped token totals and produce a corrected invoiceable token count. Will post numbers in ~30m.

matt_billing: If dedupe delta ~512 USD we should offer a credit now and queue the invoice correction. Finance: we need an audit trail.

oliver_support: Dedupe run results: invoice tokens 1,234,567 -> deduped tokens 617,301 (difference 617,266 tokens). 

matt_billing: That matches the dashboard magnitude. Estimated dollar difference = $498.12 on token line + $14 for plan proration rounding = $512.12.

emma_csm: Customer asked for a credit and an ETA to fix. They've paused growth plans until resolved.

kevin_prod: I'll open an incident and start a hotfix rollout to restore idempotency propagation. Tagging deploy-bot: please create a canary pipeline and one-click rollback.

deploy-bot: created incident INC-2026-115, canary pipeline triggered for streaming-proxy hotfix.

alisa_eng: Hotfix branch ready. Will include unit for reconnect path and an end-to-end harness. Deploying canary now.

matt_billing: Proposed customer-facing resolution: (1) Immediate one-time credit for $512.12 applied to GreenLeaf account, (2) Reissue corrected invoice and email notification, (3) Postmortem + timeline. Thoughts?

kevin_prod: Agree. Also schedule an ops postmortem and include rollout blocker to prevent automatic stable promotion when health is superficially green.

oliver_support: I'll attach the dedupe SQL results and logs to the ticket and DM finance for the credit approval.

emma_csm: I'll send the customer a short note: acknowledge escalation, say root cause identified as transient streaming reconnect duplicate counting, promise a credit and corrected invoice within 48h, and offer a follow-up call. Will tag once sent. :email:

matt_billing: Copy — finance please prepare $512.12 credit and hold on the account until corrected invoice issues. @matt_billing will approve.

deploy-bot: canary succeeded on 3/3 hosts, rolling out to rest in 10 minutes.

alisa_eng: Hotfix green. Recon run post-fix shows no duplicate request_id counts in the same window.

oliver_support: Re-run dedupe after fix: corrected invoice tokens = 617,301, final delta = 617,266 tokens.

matt_billing: Finance applied $512.12 credit and generated corrected invoice draft. I'll send to GreenLeaf with note.

emma_csm: Customer emailed back: "Thanks — appreciate the quick response. We'll accept the credit and want a short postmortem." I'll coordinate the follow-up call.

kevin_prod: Closing loop: incident INC-2026-115 -> status resolved, postmortem in eng-docs in 72h.

oliver_support: Addendum: running a sweep across other orgs for similar duplicate patterns for the same window; found 7 orgs with minor duplicates (<2k tokens) — finance decision on whether do automated credits or case-by-case.

matt_billing: We'll cut credits for the ones >$100 and open CS cases for the rest.

emma_csm: Thanks team. I'll update GreenLeaf thread and close this internal thread once customer confirms invoice acceptance.
